nodes.label: UI Sound On Icon (speaker with sound waves)
nodes.description: Flat monochrome white/near-white glyph of a loudspeaker cone emitting three concentric arcs, on a transparent/very light background. Depicts audio enabled. Belongs to the Thaira UI control system (audio toggle button); art style is a minimal solid-fill silhouette pictogram, not pixel art, sized as a small square icon for HUD/settings buttons.
